description: Modifies the original Settings class provided by the user

client_exponential_backoff_max.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait between retries when using exponential backoff retry strategies. The client timeout might need to be adjusted accordingly.
client_exponential_backoff_max.title: Client Exponential Backoff Max

client_num_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed API calls.
client_num_retries.title: Client Num Retries

client_retry_status_codes.description: List of status codes that should trigger retrying a request.
client_retry_status_codes.title: Client Retry Status Codes

client_reraise_from_retry_error.description: Specifies if the exception wrapped in the final RetryError is reraised or the RetryError is returned as is.
client_reraise_from_retry_error.title: Client Reraise From Retry Error

per_request_jitter.description: Max amount of jitter (in seconds) to add to each request.
per_request_jitter.title: Per Request Jitter

retry_after_applicable_for_num_requests.description: Amount of requests after which the stored delay from a 429 response is ignored again. Can be useful to adjust if concurrent requests are fired in quick succession.
retry_after_applicable_for_num_requests.title: Retry After Applicable For Num Requests

data_hub_crypt4gh_public_key_path.description: Path to the Data Hub's Crypt4GH public key file. Only needed for running `dhfs verify`.
data_hub_crypt4gh_public_key_path.title: Data Hub Crypt4Gh Public Key Path

inbox_bucket_id.description: The inbox bucket ID - only needed for running `dhfs verify`.
inbox_bucket_id.title: Inbox Bucket Id

inbox_write_s3_access_key_id.description: S3 access key ID with write access to the inbox bucket. Only needed for running `dhfs verify`.
inbox_write_s3_access_key_id.title: Inbox Write S3 Access Key Id

inbox_write_s3_secret_access_key.description: S3 secret access key with write access to the inbox bucket. Only needed for running `dhfs verify`.
inbox_write_s3_secret_access_key.title: Inbox Write S3 Secret Access Key

inbox_write_s3_session_token.description: Optional S3 session token for the write-capable inbox credentials. Only needed for running `dhfs verify`.
inbox_write_s3_session_token.title: Inbox Write S3 Session Token

data_hub_crypt4gh_private_key_path.description: Path to the Data Hub's Crypt4GH private key file
data_hub_crypt4gh_private_key_path.title: Data Hub Crypt4Gh Private Key Path

data_hub_crypt4gh_private_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase needed to read the content of the private key file. Only needed if the private key is encrypted.
data_hub_crypt4gh_private_key_passphrase.title: Data Hub Crypt4Gh Private Key Passphrase

central_api_crypt4gh_public_key.description: The Crypt4GH public key used by the Central API. This is used to encrypt new file encryption secrets.
central_api_crypt4gh_public_key.title: Central Api Crypt4Gh Public Key

central_api_url.description: The base URL used to connect to to the GHGA Central API
central_api_url.title: Central Api Url

data_hub_signing_key.description: The Data Hub's private JWK for signing JWT auth tokens
data_hub_signing_key.title: Data Hub Signing Key

storage_alias.description: An alias identifying the Data Hub at which this instance of DHFS is running. This value should be set in coordination with GHGA Central.
storage_alias.title: Storage Alias

s3_access_key_id.description: Part of credentials for login into the S3 service. See: https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/guide/credentials.html
s3_access_key_id.title: S3 Access Key Id

s3_secret_access_key.description: Part of credentials for login into the S3 service. See: https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/guide/credentials.html
s3_secret_access_key.title: S3 Secret Access Key

s3_session_token.description: Part of credentials for login into the S3 service. See: https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/guide/credentials.html
s3_session_token.title: S3 Session Token

aws_config_ini.description: Path to a config file for specifying more advanced S3 parameters. This should follow the format described here: https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/guide/configuration.html#using-a-configuration-file
aws_config_ini.title: Aws Config Ini

log_level.description: The minimum log level to capture.
log_level.title: Log Level

service_instance_id.description: A string that uniquely identifies this instance across all instances of this service. This is included in log messages.
service_instance_id.title: Service Instance Id

log_format.description: If set, will replace JSON formatting with the specified string format. If not set, has no effect. In addition to the standard attributes, the following can also be specified: timestamp, service, instance, level, correlation_id, and details
log_format.title: Log Format

log_traceback.description: Whether to include exception tracebacks in log messages.
log_traceback.title: Log Traceback

min_run_interval_seconds.description: The minimum number of seconds to wait before asking the CentralAPI about new files for interrogation.
min_run_interval_seconds.title: Min Run Interval Seconds

interrogation_bucket_id.description: The name for the S3 'interrogation' bucket, which houses re-encrypted files until they are copied to permanent storage by IFRS.
interrogation_bucket_id.title: Interrogation Bucket Id

max_concurrent_files.description: How many files from a batch to process at the same time. This bounds how many multipart uploads are open at once. It does not affect memory use: that is governed by max_concurrent_parts alone.
max_concurrent_files.title: Max Concurrent Files

max_concurrent_parts.description: How many file parts to process at the same time, counted across all files being processed concurrently. This lets the download of one part overlap the re-encryption of another and the upload of a third, and it is the service's memory budget: peak use is roughly max_concurrent_parts * 3 * the part size, no matter how many files are in flight. Files share the budget, so a single large file can use all of it. It also sizes the thread pool that runs decryption, re-encryption and hashing.
max_concurrent_parts.title: Max Concurrent Parts

max_concurrent_deletions.description: How many objects the cleanup routine deletes from the interrogation bucket at the same time. Each deletion is its own request, so a serial cleanup costs one round trip per object. Deletions hold no file data, so this only trades against load on the S3 backend.
max_concurrent_deletions.title: Max Concurrent Deletions

library_log_level.description: The log level to use for libraries. This option can be used in tandem with log_level to view DEBUG logs from DHFS without the noise of third-party libraries. Will be overridden by log_level if log_level is higher. By default, this is set to CRITICAL, which will suppress all logs with a log level lower than CRITICAL.
library_log_level.title: Library Log Level

library_logger_names.description: The list of logger names to target with library_log_level.
library_logger_names.title: Library Logger Names

title: ModSettings
